title: gibbsReactor operation
description: Gibbs reactor: equilibrium composition from minimising the total Gibbs free energy subject to atom-balance constraints. Three selectable `model` paths: elementPotential (gas), reactiveFlash (multi-condensable, NRTL) and directMin (multi-start Nelder-Mead).

T.title: Operating temperature
T.description: Temperature at which the equilibrium is evaluated.

P.title: Operating pressure
P.description: Pressure at which the equilibrium is evaluated; enters the ideal-gas chemical potential mu = mu_pure(T) + RT ln(y_i P / 1 bar).

elements.title: Atomic elements
elements.description: Chemical elements for the atom-balance constraints (one per element). Each species lists its atom counts in this order.

species.title: Candidate species
species.description: Candidate species in the equilibrium mixture, each with its atom counts (one per element).

name.title: Component name (must be in the declared component set)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: isothermal (default; `T` holds and the duty is the result) or adiabatic. In adiabatic mode `T` is the Newton's SEED, not the answer.

Q.title: Imposed duty
Q.description: Heat added per kmol of feed, for a non-adiabatic non-isothermal case; defaults to 0.

temperatureApproach.title: Equilibrium approach (announced)
temperatureApproach.description: Detune the equilibrium: the REACTION is evaluated at (T + this) while the physical state stays at T — enthalpy, Psat and the energy balance do not move. ANNOUNCED on every run and published as the KPI temperatureApproach_K. THE SIGN FOLLOWS THE HEAT OF REACTION, NOT A CONVENTION: an exothermic reaction (ammonia synthesis) under-predicts when the equilibrium is evaluated at a HIGHER temperature, so positive; an endothermic one (steam reforming) at a LOWER one, so negative. There is deliberately no lower bound of zero. It is EMPIRICAL (calibrated, never predicted) and GLOBAL (one number; it cannot resolve per-reaction approaches), and at high pressure it will absorb missing fugacity corrections.

approachTemperature.title: Equilibrium approach (second key, unannounced)
approachTemperature.description: A SECOND approach key read by the same solve (GibbsReactor.cpp:65), and a DIFFERENT model: it shifts the whole equilibrium evaluation to (T + this), so Psat and the fugacity coefficients move with the chemistry, where temperatureApproach shifts the chemistry alone. It announces nothing and publishes no KPI, and the two ADD when both are declared. Prefer temperatureApproach. This description previously said "Solve the equilibrium at (T − this)" and "is ANNOUNCED when non-zero", and carried a minimum of 0; all three were false and are corrected here (2026-09-25).
